schedules.title: Catalysts & Crossroads: Leading Legal Change in Complex Times

timeLineItems.title: Registration & Breakfast Networking
Opening Remarks
timeLineItems.description: Brief remarks to kick off the Conference.

timeLineItems.title: Headwinds & Whirlwinds: Legal Leadership in an Age of Uncertainty
timeLineItems.description:
Across Africa, in-house legal teams are facing increasing pressure to navigate fast-changing regulatory and political landscapes. From shifting government policies to fragmented compliance regimes, the headwinds are real and the whirlwinds, frequent. According to the 2025 GC Survey, regulatory uncertainty is now the top concern for General Counsel across the continent. In this powerful, survey-led plenary, senior legal leaders from across Africa will share how they are:
 – Responding to legal and regulatory volatility across jurisdictions
 – Engaging policymakers to influence outcomes
 – Supporting their organisations through change, complexity and risk
 – Building resilient, future-ready legal teams

timeLineItems.title: The Catalyst Effect – Legal Leadership in a World of Breakthroughs.
timeLineItems.description: The ACGC Keynote is always a defining moment of the conference and this year is no exception. In this bold and inspiring address, renowned entrepreneur and former in-house legal leader Monica Musonda will explore what it means to be a catalyst in today’s complex business and legal landscape. Drawing on her remarkable journey from General Counsel of a pan-African conglomerate to the founder of one of Zambia’s most recognised food companies, Monica will speak candidly about the evolving role of legal leadership  and how in house counsel across Africa can be drivers of transformation, innovation, and ethical strategy

speakers.name: Monica Musonda
speakers.title: CEO & Founder, Java Foods, Former General Counsel, Dangote Group, Archbishop Tutu Fellow & World Economic Forum Young Global Leader (Zambia)

timeLineItems.title: Unpacking the Catalyst: From Reflection to Real Change
timeLineItems.description:
Monica Musonda’s keynote sets a bold vision for legal leadership but what happens next is just as important. In this follow-on session, a panel of senior in-house counsel join Monica to reflect on the themes raised in The Catalyst Effect and explore Monica’s ideas in the context of their own leadership journey. They will share what resonates, what challenges them, and how they are translating bold vision into meaningful action inside their organisations.
This session is  about what hap
pens when you return to your desk with a renewed sense of purpose but face the same complexity and competing demands?

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Future-Proofing Legal: Managing Budgets & Proving Value
timeLineItems.description: Explore strategies for managing lean budgets while delivering strategic value. Topics include unlocking new funding models, measuring legal impact (KPI frameworks), and building cases for investment in legal tech.

timeLineItems.title: The Culture Exchange: Public vs Private Approaches to Legal Team Performance
timeLineItems.description: This session brings together public and corporate legal professionals to share what each sector does best and where they can learn from each other. From talent development to morale, values, and accountability, explore practical ways to shape resilient legal teams that perform with purpose.

timeLineItems.title: Managing Emerging Risks for African Businesses: How In-House Counsel can Lead Through Uncertainty
timeLineItems.description: Unpack how legal leaders are managing cross-border risks, shifting compliance demands, and emerging challenges like ESG and cyber. This session shares practical risk leadership strategies for navigating uncertainty with confidence, clarity, and cross-functional impact.

timeLineItems.title: Beyond the Billable Hour: Building Strategic Relationships with External Counsel
timeLineItems.description: Redefine your relationship with external firms moving from outsourcing to co-creation. Learn how to co-develop playbooks, drive consistent performance, and build agile partnerships that scale.

timeLineItems.title: From the Room to the Floor – Lessons, Shifts & Surprises
timeLineItems.description: Rapid-fire debrief that captures the energy, insights, and “aha” moments from each breakout room followed by fresh takes and reactions from the audience. What did we learn that’s worth carrying forward?

timeLineItems.title: Closing Remarks
ACGC Conference Welcome Drinks
The ACGC Morning Mindfulness with FitnessXpress Zambia
Embedding ESG Beyond Compliance – From Reporting to Reputation
timeLineItems.description: A practical discussion on how ESG is evolving in real time. Led by in-house leaders and ESG specialists who are moving the agenda from box-ticking to boardroom impact.

timeLineItems.title: Zambia Edition: Why the World Wants Zambia’s Copper
timeLineItems.description:
This year marks the launch of a new ACGC conference feature: the GeoBrief. A country-focused spotlight offering strategic insight into a key issue shaping each host nation.
From now on, every ACGC conference will include one of these sessions giving delegates a quick but valuable window into the legal, commercial, and political forces defining that jurisdiction.We begin in Zambia  and there's no better place to start than with copper. Zambia sits at the heart of the global copper story but why is the world so hungry for it now? What’s driving demand, who’s controlling supply, and why should lawyers care? This fast-paced, informative session is part economics, part geopolitics, and part insider’s guide to a resource shaping the future of energy, tech, and African industrial policy.

timeLineItems.title: Trade Wars, Uncertainty & Shifting Global Order: Can the AfCFTA Accelerate Resilience in pan-African Trade & Regional Integration?
timeLineItems.description:
Deep dive into AfCFTA regulations & implications for in-house counsel.
1. The reality of cross-border legal frameworks & trade.
2. Lessons from companies leveraging AfCFTA to expand across Africa.
3. Live audience engagement through scenario-based polling.
4. Connects trade agreements to the daily work of in-house counsel.

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Professional Development Breakouts
Towards a Unified Competition Landscape for Cross-Border Businesses: Navigating National, Regional, and AfCFTA Regimes:
timeLineItems.description: This session examines the legal and strategic implications of Africa’s shifting competition law environment. From domestic enforcement to regional blocs and AfCFTA-level developments, speakers will explore how regulators, businesses, and in-house counsel are working towards greater coherence. Learn what legal teams should anticipate as the continent moves slowly but decisively toward a more integrated competition framework.

timeLineItems.title: Resilient Counsel: Protecting Your Mental Health & Sustaining Legal Careers:
timeLineItems.description: The ACGC GC Survey revealed a troubling undercurrent across Africa’s in-house legal community: nearly half of respondents reported feeling emotionally depleted or professionally isolated at least once a month. Many cited relentless workloads, blurred boundaries, and the pressure of being the sole ethical voice in the room , all without access to formal mental health or wellbeing support. This session opens up an honest conversation about what it takes to build and sustain a legal career under pressure. We’ll explore the realities of burnout, the myth of the always-available lawyer, and how legal professionals can carve out space for resilience, reflection, and longevity without compromising ambition or integrity. This is about protecting the people who protect the business. Because resilience isn’t a buzzword it’s a survival skill.

timeLineItems.title: Speaking Up, Standing Firm: What Courage Looks Like in the Legal Profession Today
timeLineItems.description: The UK Post Office scandal reminded the world and especially in-house lawyers of what happens when silence is easier than standing up. At ACGC 2024, we examined that case as a cautionary tale. One year later, we ask: has anything changed? Are we braver, better equipped or still afraid of being “the difficult voice in the room”? According to the ACGC GC Survey, 41% of legal departments now formally oversee ethics, and nearly 1 in 3 in-house counsel say they’ve felt pressure to stay quiet in the face of misconduct or risk. As the boundaries between law, ethics, and reputation continue to blur, the emotional and professional cost of silence is rising.

timeLineItems.title: The Live Lab: Solving Real Compliance Challenges Together:
timeLineItems.description: A hands-on, scenario-driven session for in-house counsel.Open to all ACGC 2025 delegates.Certification applies only to participants enrolled in the ACGC Compliance Essentials programme.This interactive session puts you in the legal hot seat. Designed as a practical extension of the ACGC Compliance Essentials programme, the Live Lab invites participants to step into a high-stakes scenario drawn from real-world regulatory challenges faced by African businesses. Working through a case study attendees will analyse risks, make strategic calls, and explore how in-house legal teams can respond under pressure while balancing law, ethics, business realities, and limited information. Whether you’re an experienced GC or growing compliance lead, this session offers a rare chance to sharpen your instincts in a collaborative, scenario-based setting.

timeLineItems.title: Closing Remarks
Social Time
ACGC Advisory Board Meeting & Private Dinner (Invite-Only)

schedules.title: The Breakthrough: In-House Skills & Strategic Leadership

timeLineItems.title: ACGC Morning Wellness
Navigating the Next Evolution of AI in LegalOps: A Strategic Workshop for Modern Legal Counsel
timeLineItems.description:
The AI era has arrived but most legal teams are still figuring out how to move from curiosity to capability. This hands-on strategic workshop will cut through the hype and deliver a clear, practical understanding of how legal departments can leverage AI to drive efficiency, manage risk, and unlock real value across legal operations.Whether you’re just starting to explore AI or already experimenting with tools, this session will help you:
Understand the shift to Legal Ops 3.0 — from process optimisation to strategic legal intelligence


Demystify today’s AI tools and use cases — including their benefits, risks, and limitations


Learn practical implementation strategies — from procurement and governance to real-world prompt engineering
Through live demos, case studies, and expert insights, this workshop is designed to equip in-house counsel with the confidence and clarity to lead their teams into the next evolution of legal work.

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Guardians of Trust: Operationalising Data Protection, Privacy & Governance
timeLineItems.description:
Many legal teams understand the laws but still struggle to embed data protection and privacy into day-to-day operations. This practical, classroom-based session is designed to bridge that gap. Building on previous sessions that unpacked the data protection legal frameworks, this year’s skills workshop focuses on how in-house counsel can turn those frameworks into real accountability: aligning people, processes, and policies to reduce risk and uphold trust. Participants will work through realistic scenarios and learn how to:
1. Identify and close implementation gaps across teams
2. Manage sensitive information in fast-moving business environments
3. Strengthen governance around internal data handling, third-party risk, and emerging technologies
4. Offer credible legal guidance as AI and automation create new compliance blind spots

timeLineItems.title: Closing Remarks

schedules.title: ACGC in Livingstone: Let’s Discover Zambia Together - by Maxmas Travel & Tours

timeLineItems.title: Victoria Falls
timeLineItems.description: A guided visit to Victoria Falls,One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. All transport from the hotel is included.

timeLineItems.title: Mukuni Village
timeLineItems.description: A cultural stop at Mukuni Village, home to one of Zambia’s oldest villages, still guided by traditional leadership. All transport from the hotel is included.
A scenic sunset cruise on the Zambezi River, with onboard snacks and a full bar included. All transport from the hotel is included.
timeLineItems.title: Zambezi River

timeLineItems.description:
Indicative Pricing: $195 per person (includes all tours, entry fees, transfers, snacks, and drinks on the sunset cruise) 
 
Optional lunch add-on: $30 (includes set menu, mineral water, and soft drink. Must be pre-booked by 20th September).

The full excursion, including the cruise, will proceed with a minimum of 20 confirmed participants. Places are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
 
Whether you’re coming solo or with colleagues, this is a chance to see a different side of Zambia and make memories with fellow ACGC conference delegates in one of Africa’s most breathtaking settings.
timeLineItems.title: Pricing & Information

pageContent.aboutSection:
ACGC creates the connections for members within and across jurisdictions, industries, and sectors both in Africa and beyond to share good practice and promote a culture of innovation amongst its members. ACGC recognizes the evolution that has occurred in relation to in-house roles across the continent and aims to ensure that lawyers working in African corporates and government departments have meaningful opportunities to learn, discuss and debate what the future holds and how they can contribute meaningfully to the growth of their companies and governments, their own personal development and that of the legal profession as a whole.

#ACGC4B, #Africaninhouse, #Generalcounselafrica, #Govtcounselafrica, #Corporatecounselafrica

At ACGC 2024, we examined that case as a cautionary tale. One year later, we ask: has anything changed? Are we braver, better equipped or still afraid of being “the difficult voice in the room”? According to the ACGC GC Survey, 41% of legal departments now formally oversee ethics, and nearly 1 in 3 in-house counsel say they’ve felt pressure to stay quiet in the face of misconduct or risk. As the boundaries between law, ethics, and reputation continue to blur, the emotional and professional cost of silence is rising.

timeLineItems.title: The Live Lab: Solving Real Compliance Challenges Together:
timeLineItems.description: A hands-on, scenario-driven session for in-house counsel.Open to all ACGC 2025 delegates.Certification applies only to participants enrolled in the ACGC Compliance Essentials programme.This interactive session puts you in the legal hot seat. Designed as a practical extension of the ACGC Compliance Essentials programme, the Live Lab invites participants to step into a high-stakes scenario drawn from real-world regulatory challenges faced by African businesses. Working through a case study attendees will analyse risks, make strategic calls, and explore how in-house legal teams can respond under pressure while balancing law, ethics, business realities, and limited information. Whether you’re an experienced GC or growing compliance lead, this session offers a rare chance to sharpen your instincts in a collaborative, scenario-based setting.

timeLineItems.title: ACGC Morning Wellness
Navigating the Next Evolution of AI in LegalOps: A Strategic Workshop for Modern Legal Counsel
timeLineItems.description:
The AI era has arrived but most legal teams are still figuring out how to move from curiosity to capability. This hands-on strategic workshop will cut through the hype and deliver a clear, practical understanding of how legal departments can leverage AI to drive efficiency, manage risk, and unlock real value across legal operations.Whether you’re just starting to explore AI or already experimenting with tools, this session will help you:
Understand the shift to Legal Ops 3.0 — from process optimisation to strategic legal intelligence


Demystify today’s AI tools and use cases — including their benefits, risks, and limitations


Learn practical implementation strategies — from procurement and governance to real-world prompt engineering
Through live demos, case studies, and expert insights, this workshop is designed to equip in-house counsel with the confidence and clarity to lead their teams into the next evolution of legal work.

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Guardians of Trust: Operationalising Data Protection, Privacy & Governance
timeLineItems.description:
Many legal teams understand the laws but still struggle to embed data protection and privacy into day-to-day operations. This practical, classroom-based session is designed to bridge that gap. Building on previous sessions that unpacked the data protection legal frameworks, this year’s skills workshop focuses on how in-house counsel can turn those frameworks into real accountability: aligning people, processes, and policies to reduce risk and uphold trust. Participants will work through realistic scenarios and learn how to:
1. Identify and close implementation gaps across teams
2. Manage sensitive information in fast-moving business environments
3. Strengthen governance around internal data handling, third-party risk, and emerging technologies
4. Offer credible legal guidance as AI and automation create new compliance blind spots

pageContent.aboutSection:
ACGC creates the connections for members within and across jurisdictions, industries, and sectors both in Africa and beyond to share good practice and promote a culture of innovation amongst its members. ACGC recognizes the evolution that has occurred in relation to in-house roles across the continent and aims to ensure that lawyers working in African corporates and government departments have meaningful opportunities to learn, discuss and debate what the future holds and how they can contribute meaningfully to the growth of their companies and governments, their own personal development and that of the legal profession as a whole.

schedules.title: Catalysts & Crossroads: Leading Legal Change in Complex Times

timeLineItems.title: Registration & Breakfast Networking
Opening Remarks
timeLineItems.description: Brief remarks to kick off the Conference.

timeLineItems.title: Headwinds & Whirlwinds: Legal Leadership in an Age of Uncertainty
timeLineItems.description:
Across Africa, in-house legal teams are facing increasing pressure to navigate fast-changing regulatory and political landscapes. From shifting government policies to fragmented compliance regimes, the headwinds are real and the whirlwinds, frequent. According to the 2025 GC Survey, regulatory uncertainty is now the top concern for General Counsel across the continent. In this powerful, survey-led plenary, senior legal leaders from across Africa will share how they are:
 – Responding to legal and regulatory volatility across jurisdictions
 – Engaging policymakers to influence outcomes
 – Supporting their organisations through change, complexity and risk
 – Building resilient, future-ready legal teams

timeLineItems.title: The Catalyst Effect – Legal Leadership in a World of Breakthroughs.
timeLineItems.description: The ACGC Keynote is always a defining moment of the conference and this year is no exception. In this bold and inspiring address, renowned entrepreneur and former in-house legal leader Monica Musonda will explore what it means to be a catalyst in today’s complex business and legal landscape. Drawing on her remarkable journey from General Counsel of a pan-African conglomerate to the founder of one of Zambia’s most recognised food companies, Monica will speak candidly about the evolving role of legal leadership  and how in house counsel across Africa can be drivers of transformation, innovation, and ethical strategy

speakers.name: Monica Musonda
speakers.title: CEO & Founder, Java Foods, Former General Counsel, Dangote Group, Archbishop Tutu Fellow & World Economic Forum Young Global Leader (Zambia)

timeLineItems.title: Unpacking the Catalyst: From Reflection to Real Change
timeLineItems.description:
Monica Musonda’s keynote sets a bold vision for legal leadership but what happens next is just as important. In this follow-on session, a panel of senior in-house counsel join Monica to reflect on the themes raised in The Catalyst Effect and explore Monica’s ideas in the context of their own leadership journey. They will share what resonates, what challenges them, and how they are translating bold vision into meaningful action inside their organisations.
This session is  about what hap
pens when you return to your desk with a renewed sense of purpose but face the same complexity and competing demands?

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Future-Proofing Legal: Managing Budgets & Proving Value
timeLineItems.description: Explore strategies for managing lean budgets while delivering strategic value. Topics include unlocking new funding models, measuring legal impact (KPI frameworks), and building cases for investment in legal tech.

timeLineItems.title: The Culture Exchange: Public vs Private Approaches to Legal Team Performance
timeLineItems.description: This session brings together public and corporate legal professionals to share what each sector does best and where they can learn from each other. From talent development to morale, values, and accountability, explore practical ways to shape resilient legal teams that perform with purpose.

timeLineItems.title: Managing Emerging Risks for African Businesses: How In-House Counsel can Lead Through Uncertainty
timeLineItems.description: Unpack how legal leaders are managing cross-border risks, shifting compliance demands, and emerging challenges like ESG and cyber. This session shares practical risk leadership strategies for navigating uncertainty with confidence, clarity, and cross-functional impact.

timeLineItems.title: Beyond the Billable Hour: Building Strategic Relationships with External Counsel
timeLineItems.description: Redefine your relationship with external firms moving from outsourcing to co-creation. Learn how to co-develop playbooks, drive consistent performance, and build agile partnerships that scale.

timeLineItems.title: From the Room to the Floor – Lessons, Shifts & Surprises
timeLineItems.description: Rapid-fire debrief that captures the energy, insights, and “aha” moments from each breakout room followed by fresh takes and reactions from the audience. What did we learn that’s worth carrying forward?

timeLineItems.title: Closing Remarks
ACGC Conference Welcome Drinks
The ACGC Morning Mindfulness with FitnessXpress Zambia
Embedding ESG Beyond Compliance – From Reporting to Reputation
timeLineItems.description: A practical discussion on how ESG is evolving in real time. Led by in-house leaders and ESG specialists who are moving the agenda from box-ticking to boardroom impact.

timeLineItems.title: Zambia Edition: Why the World Wants Zambia’s Copper
timeLineItems.description:
This year marks the launch of a new ACGC conference feature: the GeoBrief. A country-focused spotlight offering strategic insight into a key issue shaping each host nation.
From now on, every ACGC conference will include one of these sessions giving delegates a quick but valuable window into the legal, commercial, and political forces defining that jurisdiction.We begin in Zambia  and there's no better place to start than with copper. Zambia sits at the heart of the global copper story but why is the world so hungry for it now? What’s driving demand, who’s controlling supply, and why should lawyers care? This fast-paced, informative session is part economics, part geopolitics, and part insider’s guide to a resource shaping the future of energy, tech, and African industrial policy.

timeLineItems.title: Trade Wars, Uncertainty & Shifting Global Order: Can the AfCFTA Accelerate Resilience in pan-African Trade & Regional Integration?
timeLineItems.description:
Deep dive into AfCFTA regulations & implications for in-house counsel.
1. The reality of cross-border legal frameworks & trade.
2. Lessons from companies leveraging AfCFTA to expand across Africa.
3. Live audience engagement through scenario-based polling.
4. Connects trade agreements to the daily work of in-house counsel.

timeLineItems.title: Networking Lunch
Professional Development Breakouts
Towards a Unified Competition Landscape for Cross-Border Businesses: Navigating National, Regional, and AfCFTA Regimes:
timeLineItems.description: This session examines the legal and strategic implications of Africa’s shifting competition law environment. From domestic enforcement to regional blocs and AfCFTA-level developments, speakers will explore how regulators, businesses, and in-house counsel are working towards greater coherence. Learn what legal teams should anticipate as the continent moves slowly but decisively toward a more integrated competition framework.

timeLineItems.title: Resilient Counsel: Protecting Your Mental Health & Sustaining Legal Careers:
timeLineItems.description: The ACGC GC Survey revealed a troubling undercurrent across Africa’s in-house legal community: nearly half of respondents reported feeling emotionally depleted or professionally isolated at least once a month. Many cited relentless workloads, blurred boundaries, and the pressure of being the sole ethical voice in the room , all without access to formal mental health or wellbeing support. This session opens up an honest conversation about what it takes to build and sustain a legal career under pressure. We’ll explore the realities of burnout, the myth of the always-available lawyer, and how legal professionals can carve out space for resilience, reflection, and longevity without compromising ambition or integrity. This is about protecting the people who protect the business. Because resilience isn’t a buzzword it’s a survival skill.
